_about: 2026 世界杯冠军是否来自南美洲的冻结证据包。信息截至 2026-06-01；使用 FIFA 截点前排名与赛前热门分析。

evidence.title: France reclaim top spot in the FIFA/Coca-Cola Men's World Ranking
evidence.excerpt: France now lead the way. Spain and Argentina are second and third respectively.
evidence.claim: 截至 4 月 FIFA 排名，前两位均为欧洲球队，南美最高的阿根廷位列第三，冠军地区归属并非明显偏向南美。

evidence.title: What happened to the FIFA World Cup favourites?
evidence.excerpt: Spain are the marginal favourites to win the FIFA World Cup 2026.
evidence.claim: FIFA 在 5 月赛前文章中把欧洲球队西班牙列为边际夺冠热门，给“冠军来自南美”提供反向事前信号。
